reviews.comment: She is extremely proficient at reading off the slides. Other than that there are no positives from the professor. No industry experience, nor relevant contemporary examples. I like the course material and readings, but lectures are Einstein time dilation: near the event horizon, time drags to infinity. You look at the clock more than the professor.

Very good lecturer and overall kind and helpful person. Tests are MCQ and very doable if you pay attention and skim the textbook. Pick a good group for projects, they're 50% of the grade, but very doable if you plan ahead and put in effort. She mainly wants to see that you're trying and working with your group, so don't stress too much.

Professor Dwivedi is one of my favorite profs I've ever had. She genuinely cares about her students and what she is teaching, making the class very engaging. She loves for students to participate even if they are wrong, and frequently encourages her students to engage with each other. I loved this class and would take her again in a heartbeat!

I took MGMT 466 with Professor Dwivedi which is required for all students at Mays. She is an amazing professor who really cares about her students. She creates a welcoming environment & I always enjoyed her lectures. Group work is important in this class but she lets you choose. The course consists of 2 tests, 2 presentations, & 1 report.

Professor Priyanka really cares about her students and clearly puts a lot of effort into teaching this course. There is a lot of group work, which isn't my favorite but the class itself is very interesting. I wouldn't say the textbook is super necessary but it is helpful when studying for the exams, or to catch up if you missed class.
